subject.title: [Feature]: Expose actual AI Credits consumed per request for GitHub Copilot provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a durable, provider-neutral per-turn authoritative-billing field for GitHub Copilot AIC, or keep provider billing limited to account-level snapshots and estimated session cost?
rationale: The request introduces a billing-grade persisted usage signal whose storage, public status/export shape, and relationship to existing estimated cost are product and compatibility contracts, not merely transport parsing.

options.title: Add an authoritative per-turn billing field
options.body: Define a provider-neutral raw/normalized billing value, populate it from GitHub Copilot responses after live contract verification, and keep estimated USD separately.

options.title: Keep account-level billing only
options.body: Retain the existing provider snapshot model and document that request-level Copilot AIC is intentionally outside OpenClaw accounting.

recommendation.title: Add an authoritative per-turn billing field
recommendation.body: Define a provider-neutral raw/normalized billing value, populate it from GitHub Copilot responses after live contract verification, and keep estimated USD separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently merged the provider-billing architecture that determines whether this belongs in the shared usage contract.
